input.note:
The deployment fails because the documents namespace enforces the "restricted" PodSecurity policy [cite: concepts/security/pod-security-standards#restricted-0]. The pdf-exporter:1.5.0 pods violate this policy - they are missing required security context settings.

Error: "allowPrivilegeEscalation != false, unrestricted capabilities, runAsNonRoot != true, seccompProfile missing"

Fix: Add security context to your Deployment manifest [cite: concepts/security/pod-security-standards#restricted-1]:
```yaml
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
      - name: exporter
        securityContext:
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          capabilities:
            drop: ["ALL"]
```
